scope_tested: Source-linked scope delta; sender verifies; client corrects or confirms; no legal conclusion
secondary_awards: RevenueCat Design Award | The Growth Loop Award (Layers)
strongest_failure_reason: ClarAccord already offers the same spoken-or-message-to-structured-receipt-to-no-account-client-sign-off loop, while ThreadRecap covers post-hoc evidence.
hard_kill_threshold: Kill unless at least 3 of 5 qualified freelancers reject the close substitutes for the same source-linked correction need and at least 40% of 20 real client links are correctly confirmed within 24 hours.

scope_tested: No-account client voice link to structured brief, risks, actions, and follow-up
secondary_awards: HAMM Award (Help Apps Make Money) | The Growth Loop Award (Layers)
strongest_failure_reason: VocalJet is the proposed product almost verbatim, including target customer, no-account voice intake, structured brief, scope risks, actions, and reply text.
hard_kill_threshold: Do not advance without a new persona or job that is supported by new evidence; changing visual design or prompts is insufficient.

scope_tested: Partners claim complete responsibility; closing anticipation-through-monitoring grows a private cooperative house
secondary_awards: RevenueCat Design Award | Keep Them Coming Back Award (OneSignal)
strongest_failure_reason: The less-engaged partner may not adopt, and a cute house can silently become another task-count scoreboard that leaves the overloaded partner administering the system.
hard_kill_threshold: Kill if both partners in fewer than 3 of 5 households voluntarily use it, or if the initially overloaded partner creates more than 60% of responsibilities and reminders during the field test.

scope_tested: Minimum-necessary care request; helper accepts or declines; requester sees acknowledged coverage and fallback
strongest_failure_reason: Free incumbents already post specific care requests and accept volunteer commitments, while push delivery cannot safely establish coverage and sensitive coordination raises privacy and support burden.
hard_kill_threshold: Do not advance unless a narrowly defined user group demonstrates a coverage-certainty failure that incumbents cannot solve and the product works safely when every notification is delayed or missed.

scope_tested: C13+C14 core: preserve context, later select one feasible restart; C15 trusted-person start is prototype-only
secondary_awards: Best App for Galaxy (Samsung Galaxy) | Keep Them Coming Back Award (OneSignal)
closest_substitute: Just Start products; Focusmate; generic notes and timers
strongest_failure_reason: Users may not leave a breadcrumb before interruption, and adding a live social layer would create two-person activation, UGC moderation, and availability problems without proven incremental value.
hard_kill_threshold: Keep C15 out of MVP unless at least 3 of 5 target users request known-person support and at least 60% of recipient tests accept the exact start within 15 minutes without creating an account. Kill the core if fewer than 50% of 20 real breadcrumbs lead to a first action within two minutes of reopening.

scope_tested: Minimal activity and after-effect logging with transparent, non-causal associations
strongest_failure_reason: Rich free incumbents already provide low-friction tracking and correlations; a smaller tracker adds little value while retaining health-policy, privacy, breach, self-tracking, and false-causality risks.
hard_kill_threshold: Do not advance unless a co-designed segment identifies a non-feature value gap and a qualified health/privacy review approves the wording, data model, and risk controls.

scope_tested: Manual project checkpoint: artifact, current state, next question, and first restart action
secondary_awards: RevenueCat Design Award | Keep Them Coming Back Award (OneSignal)
closest_substitute: Pieces Long-Term Memory; GitHub Copilot Spaces and Memory; project notes
strongest_failure_reason: The job is real but broad, users already have notes and automatic context tools, and the frequency and willingness to pay may be too low for a standalone mobile app.
hard_kill_threshold: Kill or merge into Restart Thread unless 4 of 5 long-horizon learners report at least monthly re-entry, a median reconstruction cost above 15 minutes, and a prototype reduces measured resumption time by at least 30%.
